description: This file defines the FeatureDeleted event class, which models an event emitted when a feature is deleted within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes constructors, JSON serialization/deserialization, and methods for setting revision and headers.

classes.name: FeatureDeleted
classes.description: An immutable event class representing the deletion of a feature, including JSON serialization/deserialization and utility methods.

methods.name: FeatureDeleted.of
methods.description: Static factory methods to create instances of FeatureDeleted with various parameter sets, including deprecated ones.

methods.name: FeatureDeleted.fromJson
methods.description: Static factory methods to create an instance of FeatureDeleted from JSON string or object.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature that was deleted.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer resource path for the deleted feature.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the given revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Appends feature-specific payload data to the JSON object builder during serialization.

methods.description: Generates a hash code for the object.
